scope: Separate annual-template candidate: PostAuto route 96-138-1-j26-1 for the 25–27 September 2026 Schupfart Festival. The independently transcribed official timetable verifies all 32 trips at advertised major stops; full GTFS intermediate calls and out-of-canton stops remain intact. Inferred OSM paths require positive source intervals and the unchanged mean-speed review threshold. No daily feed expands.

sources.role: Official festival travel page linking both current 2026 and older 2025 PDFs; only the 2026 timetable is used.
Official branded 2026 extra-bus timetable, page 1 visually inspected; major advertised calls and transfer boundaries, not every GTFS intermediate platform or a precise road itinerary.

source.note: Service dates are printed dates, not publication dates. After-midnight returns remain attached to the advertised festival evening, using GTFS times above 24:00. The PDF URL version token is not treated as a publication date. PDF creation/modification timestamps are metadata, not verified publication dates.

routing.scope: All six full AVA witness patterns tested; numerical road compatibility alone does not authorize event-path admission without timetable and source-time review.

timing.interpretation: Original minute-granularity intervals; no fabricated time or rounding allowance. The 80 km/h mean is a review threshold, not legal or operating certification.
